pdf_sha256_note: The PDF is deliberately NOT part of the delivery: it is a derivative artifact of a third-party engine, reproducible from the delivered docx by the command recorded in 6_proverki/ZIPISKA.txt. This hash therefore names a file that is intentionally absent. It is measured from the docx in the same run - the staleness guard refuses to report when the PDF predates the docx - so it cannot describe a different build.
pdf_staleness_guard: Refuses to run if the PDF mtime predates the docx mtime. Added because an earlier version pointed at an older directory and paired a live docx hash with a stale PDF measurement.
units_missing_explained: units_missing is a CONTIGUITY statistic of this text-only check, not a claim that the conversion lost text. The order-independent character-multiset difference is in render_multiset.json; the deficit sits in the monospaced listings (Courier, reported missing by the converter) and in the SEQ caption numbers, whose cached field results LibreOffice does not emit into PDF text.
converter_font_substitution: The converter reports missingFonts ["Courier"]; the report sets its listings in Courier, so the PDF substitutes a replacement face. A property of the conversion environment, recorded rather than hidden.
